title: Intersection with an effective Cartier divisor
statement: Let $X$ be an integral proper scheme over a field [def-pc-integral-scheme] [def-weil-proper-morphism] of dimension $d>0$, let $\mathcal L$ be an ample invertible sheaf [def-sc-invertible-module] [def-sc-ample], and let $s$ be a nonzero section whose zero scheme $D=Z(s)$ [def-pc-zero-scheme] is a nonempty effective Cartier divisor [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal]. Then $D$ is proper of dimension $d-1$, the restriction of $\mathcal L$ to $D$ is ample, and $(\mathcal L^{d}\cdot X)=(\mathcal L^{d-1}\cdot D).
